Bash(docker exec docker-compose-mariadb-1 mariadb -u root sortinghat_db -e "
SELECT DISTINCT e1.mk
FROM enrollments e1
INNER JOIN enrollments e2 ON e1.mk = e2.mk
WHERE e1.group_id = 1  -- Independent
  AND e2.group_id = 2  -- Interledger Foundation
ORDER BY e1.mk;")

Bash(docker exec docker-compose-mariadb-1 mariadb -u root sortinghat_db -e "
SELECT 
    p.name, 
    p.email,
    e.mk,
    COUNT(*) as independent_enrollments
FROM enrollments e
INNER JOIN profiles p ON e.mk = p.mk
WHERE e.group_id = 1  -- Independent
  AND e.mk IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT e1.mk
    FROM enrollments e1
    INNER JOIN enrollments e2 ON e1.mk = e2.mk
    WHERE e1.group_id = 1 AND e2.group_id = 2
  )
GROUP BY e.mk, p.name, p.email
ORDER BY p.name;")

Bash(docker exec docker-compose-mariadb-1 mariadb -u root sortinghat_db -e "
DELETE e FROM enrollments e
WHERE e.group_id = 1  -- Independent
  AND e.mk IN (
    SELECT mk FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT e1.mk
      FROM enrollments e1
      INNER JOIN enrollments e2 ON e1.mk = e2.mk
      WHERE e1.group_id = 1 AND e2.group_id = 2
    ) AS dual_enrollments
  );")

Bash(docker exec docker-compose-mariadb-1 mariadb -u root sortinghat_db -e "
SELECT COUNT(*) as remaining_independent_enrollments
FROM enrollments e
WHERE e.group_id = 1  -- Independent
  AND e.mk IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT e2.mk
    FROM enrollments e2
    WHERE e2.group_id = 2  -- Interledger Foundation
  );")

Bash(docker exec docker-compose-mariadb-1 mariadb -u root sortinghat_db -e "
SELECT 
    p.name, 
    g.name as organization,
    COUNT(*) as enrollments
FROM enrollments e
INNER JOIN profiles p ON e.mk = p.mk
INNER JOIN groups g ON e.group_id = g.id
WHERE p.name IN (''Alex Lakatos'', ''Max K'', ''SarahCoilAccount'')
GROUP BY e.mk, p.name, g.name
ORDER BY p.name, g.name;")
